module: Backend of the "preview / options" step of the Bus Route View wizard. It describes the "busRoute" mode (descriptor) and passes it to oneshotRaceCore.createConfigurator, whose result is the exported module. Here the "middle" choice is a full scenario file (scenario_scenariosLoader.getLevels("bus")); the vehicle choice is limited to public transport buses (vehicleRestrictionMode = "busRoute"). The settings are: strictStop (strict stop, true by default) and traffic (traffic, false by default). Nothing is saved (in memory only).
notes: On launch (start), the scenario is copied (deepcopy), busdriver.strictStop/traffic and userSelectedVehicle {model, config} are written into it, then scenario_scenariosLoader.start(routeFile) is called.
The highscore key is always configKey = "busRoute": the original Angular code computed a real key then ignored it; the comment says it is kept as is.
The descriptor functions (defaultSettings, onSelectMiddle, buildLevelSummary, buildMiddleSummary, getHighscoreKey, start) are local and called by oneshotRaceCore; they are not exported.
A level's size is displayed in the form "%d m x %d m" from levelInfo.size.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded beforehand: scenario_scenariosLoader, core_highscores, ui_vehicleSelector_general, ui_busRouteSelector_general.
